editionContext.figureSpecificInterpretation: Both editions introduce Figure 27 as the simplest capacitor-and-coil oscillatory circuit. The subsequent battery and switch charging procedure explicitly belongs to Figure 28a, not Figure 27; the subsequent state narrative belongs to Figure 29. Resistance is a later explanation of real losses, not an instruction to add a separate resistor to Figure 27.

sourceInventoryMapping.basis: One shared circuit frame confirmed in the original and both previews; the complete 11-object list introduces no other circuit component.

Three visible source turns map to three visible modern lobes. Count and point-on-circle assertions alone do not establish continuity; shared arc endpoints and both lead joins were independently checked and observed.
Exactly two parallel plate segments; leads terminate at their respective plate midpoints. Positive centerline and stroke-edge separation is confirmed independently and visually.

Clockwise from the upper coil endpoint reaches the upper plate without a break. Across the intentionally nonconducting capacitor gap, the lower plate follows the lower wire back through the three connected coil arcs. No unintended break, branch, or short is visible.

Absence checked against the entire spec object list, supplied SVG, and both previews rather than inferred from missing inventory entries: no source, battery, switch, resistor symbol, ground, label, polarity, arrow, number, scale, or extra subfigure.

mathematical.sourceFidelity: Three turns, two plates, left/right component ordering, and upper/lower connections preserved.
mathematical.topology: LC circuit topology is preserved through the capacitive element. It is not a claim of galvanic conduction across the capacitor gap.

independentReadOnlyChecks.interpretation: The conducting core is one unbranched path between the two capacitor terminals, not a short across them. Plate bars are terminal surfaces, not additional branches in the core trace.

regularization.coil: Three irregular oblique oval turn faces become three equally spaced semicircular circuit-symbol lobes; count, winding continuity, and component identity are retained.
regularization.plates: Two irregular perspective plate outlines become two parallel straight plate bars with distinct leads and an open gap.
regularization.wires: Irregular wire outlines become orthogonal, consistently stroked connections.
regularization.boundary: Equal radii, orthogonal layout, plate equality, 32-unit gap, and display dimensions are modern schematic choices, not extracted physical measurements.

mathematical.answerLeak: None; no oscillation-state arrows, signs, phase labels, formula values, or answers have been added.
